seat.note: Special election for the rest of Marco Rubio's term (expires January 2029); Gov. DeSantis appointed Ashley Moody in January 2025 after Rubio resigned to become secretary of state.

nomineesSource: Chosen in the Aug. 18, 2026 party primaries: Sen. Ashley Moody won the Republican primary and state Rep. Angie Nixon of Jacksonville won the Democratic primary in an upset over Alex Vindman, who conceded and endorsed her.
